name: Spearphishing Attachment
description: Adversaries send spearphishing emails with a malicious file attachment to gain execution on victim systems.

name: Spearphishing Link
description: Adversaries send spearphishing emails containing malicious hyperlinks to lure victims into credential harvesting portals or drive-by exploits.

name: Phishing for Information: Attachment
description: Adversaries send attachments specifically crafted to gather credentials, system configurations, or organization rosters.

name: Phishing for Information: Hyperlink
description: Adversaries send links to fake login pages or survey portals to elicit sensitive company credentials or 2FA codes.

name: Valid Accounts - Compromised Relay
description: Adversaries abuse legitimate or compromised mail routing credentials to bypass standard perimeter security filters.

name: User Execution: Malicious File
description: An adversary relies on the email recipient opening a weaponized document, ISO image, or archive.
